recommendations.Immediate genetic counseling is strongly: Immediate genetic counseling is strongly advised. Both partners carry high-risk genotypes. Consider advanced reproductive options such as IVF with preimplantation genetic diagnosis.
recommendations.Genetic counseling is highly recommended: Genetic counseling is highly recommended. There is a significant risk of having an affected child. Discuss family planning options with a specialist.
recommendations.Consult a genetic counselor. There is a: Consult a genetic counselor. There is a notable risk of passing the sickle cell trait or disease to your children.
recommendations.Moderate risk detected. Genetic counseli: Moderate risk detected. Genetic counseling is recommended to understand your options and plan accordingly.
recommendations.One or both partners are carriers. Child: One or both partners are carriers. Children may inherit the carrier trait. Counseling is advised.
recommendations.Low risk of having a child with sickle c: Low risk of having a child with sickle cell disease, but regular monitoring is still recommended.
recommendations.Minimal genetic risk detected. Continue: Minimal genetic risk detected. Continue regular health check-ups and consult your doctor if you have concerns.
